0022600203.text: The Lakers (9-2, first in the Pacific and the West) arrive on a five-game winning streak, with an 8-2 mark over their last ten and a 4-1 road record, while the Hawks (7-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East) are riding a four-game streak. Luka Doncic is out with back soreness, and Quentin Grimes is day-to-day with a finger injury and is a game-time decision for Los Angeles, while Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 141-116 Lakers win in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
